ground_truth.title: Free Legal Forms
ground_truth.main_content:
Interactive Legal Forms for Kansas District Courts

Kansas Legal Services (KLS) provides these easy-to-use, interactive forms as a free service to low-income Kansans. The interviews will ask simple questions and automatically fill out the documents you need for filing or responding to legal actions in Kansas district courts based on your answers.

CRITICAL WARNING: It is always wise to talk to a lawyer before proceeding in a court case on your own. Please read our important warning here.

Find the Live Chat link in the bottom left-hand corner of this page if you cannot locate a form, or have a question about the forms. Live Chat does not provide legal advice and cannot tell you what answers to put on the forms.

Live Chat is generally available Monday through Friday from 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. You can leave a message if unavailable.

Using These Forms

WORD PROCESSING PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS: The interactive court forms download for printing in Rich Text Format (.rtf), which can be opened in any word processing program (e.g., Microsoft Word). Make sure your computer chooses a word processing program to open the documents or you may encounter errors or "gibberish."

NOTE TO USERS OF CHROME and FIREFOX: The backspace button does not work to delete or modify answers in these interactive interviews. You must use arrows or your mouse to highlight the information you need to change, then use the delete key to remove letters before you can input new information. (This problem is not experienced in Explorer.)

For more help with these free legal forms, visit our Frequently Asked Questions page.

Available Forms (Listed by Category)

- Tips for filing legal documents for self-represented persons
- Instructions for requesting KLS lawyer review of your completed document

Family Law / Divorce

PLEASE NOTE (Date Validity): When filling out the divorce online forms, ensure all your dates are filled in and valid. Your document may not work without complete and valid dates. If you have trouble generating the document, go back and check the date format.

- All about Kansas divorce page
- Notice to Other Party -- Trying Again to Serve
- Divorce (no minor children) (KLS Interactive Form)
- Divorce (with minor children) (KLS Interactive Form)
- Request to Waive Filing Fee (KLS Interactive Form)
- Parenting Plan
- Child Support Worksheet (KLS) - Use this form when the combined income of both parents is less than $50,000. If income is higher, you must find a worksheet from another source.

Child Support / Parenting Time

- KLS Child Support Page
- Child Support Worksheet (KLS) - Use this KLS form when the combined income of both parents is less than $50,000.
- Child Support Worksheet & Domestic Relations Affidavit (Judicial Branch) - Use this when combined income is $50,000 or more.
- Modification of Child Support motion (Requires completed Worksheet)
- Request to Waive Filing Fees (KLS Interactive Form)

Parenting Time Instructions (Pro Se Motions)

- Instructions for Pro Se Motion to Establish Parenting Time
- Instructions for Pro Se Motion to Enforce Parenting Time
- Instructions for Pro Se Motion to Modify Parenting Time

Address Change

If your address changes, you must notify the Court, your attorney(s), and any parties involved in your case.

- Change of Address Form (Fill out, copy, and send to all necessary parties.)

Name Change

- Affidavit and order for name change (Kansas Judicial Council)
- Adult Name Change in Kansas (KLS Interactive Form)
- Request to Waive Filing Fees (KLS Interactive Form)

Paternity Action

- Kansas Paternity Action page (Helpful info for unmarried parents needing court orders for parenting time, custody, and support.)
- Form to File Paternity Action
- Reply to Paternity Action
- Final Orders in Paternity Action

Identity Theft

- KLS Identity Theft Information Page
- Letter to Creditor - Identity Theft
- Credit Report Dispute Letter
- Letter to Debt Collector - Identity Theft
- Answer to Petition for Identity Theft or Statute of Limitations

Code for Care of Children (CINC)

- Motion for Interested Party Status
- Visit the KJC Child in Need of Care page
- Request to Waive Filing Fee (KLS Interactive Form)
- Motion and Order for Interested Party Status
- Motion for a Court Appointed Attorney for Interested Party
- Order to Appoint an Attorney for an Interested Party
- Motion for Substantial Consideration of a Grandparent

Expungement of Records

- Expungement of Criminal Records (KLS Interactive Form)
- Request to Waive Filing Fee (KLS Interactive Form)

Federal Income Tax

- File your federal income taxes for free (IRS Free File)

Guardian / Conservator

- Instructions, Petition, and Order Terminating an Adult Guardianship (KLS)
- Guardian's Annual Report and Conservator's Annual Accounting (Kansas Judicial Council)
- Request to Waive Filing Fee (KLS Interactive Form)

Protection Orders

- Kansas Coalition against Sexual and Domestic Violence (KCSDV) website
- Do You Need a Protection from Abuse Order? (Screening Tool)
- Kansas Protection Order Portal (KSPOP): A free, court-funded portal for online filing.
- Protection from Abuse form (Kansas Judicial Council)
- Protection from Stalking or Sexual Assault form (Kansas Judicial Council)

Small Claims Court

- Read more about small claims court (KLS)
- Small claims information (Kansas Judicial Branch)
- Petition, summons, and defendant's claim (Kansas Judicial Council)
- Small Claims Security Deposit Form (KLS Interactive Form)
- Request to Waive Filing Fee (KLS Interactive Form)

State Income Tax

- File state income taxes for free with Kansas Web-File
- Learn how to file for Kansas Homestead Tax online.
- NOTE: The Kansas Legislature changed the law so that renters are no longer eligible for a Homestead Tax refund.

Suspended Driver's License in Kansas

Laws were changed in 2021 to make it easier for Kansas drivers to apply for a restricted license.

- Read all issues about driver's licenses in Kansas and recent changes.
- Instructions and Packet for Restricted License Eligibility.
- Request for Restricted License (KS Dept. of Revenue)

Authorization Forms

- Employment Authorization Form
- Authorization Form for the Release of Educational Records
- Authorization for Department for Children and Family Services (DCF)

General Request to Waive Filing Fees

If you do not have the funds for the filing fee required for any legal situation, you can use this interactive KLS form to ask the court for a fee waiver (ask not to have to pay the fee).

- Request to Waive Filing Fees (KLS Interactive Interview)

Self-Representation Resources & Support

- Self-Help: Visit the Kansas Judicial Branch self-help website for more information.
- FAQ: Learn more about the forms on our Free Legal Forms Frequently Asked Questions page.
- Lawyer Review: Click here to see instructions for having a KLS lawyer review your completed document.
